access_links.label: Pedestrian Counting System - Past Hour (counts per minute)

description: Pedestrian Counting System - Past Hour is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne Open Data. Current issue 23/09/2020 Please note: Sensors 67, 68 and 69 are showing duplicate records. We are currently working on a fix to resolve this. This dataset contains minute by minute directional pedestrian counts for the last hour from pedestrian sensor devices located across the city. Coverage: City of Melbourne Open Data. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne Open Data. Its tags are foot-traffic, pedestrian, safemobility, sensors, traffic-flow. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
